where: orange foliage above the upper level
desc: Orange foliage clusters appear as floating planar card cutouts without visible trunks or connecting branches.

verify.why: Visible wooden branches and frame lines clearly connect the orange foliage clusters to the surrounding structures.

where: vertical poles in the center foreground
desc: Two tall poles cross through the center foreground, obscuring sightlines to the building and pathways behind them.

verify.why: The foreground poles and cables are thin structural elements that do not obstruct readability or navigation of the scene.

desc: A wooden plank is floating in mid-air above the dirt path.

verify.why: The dark wooden plank is resting flat on the dirt terrain rather than floating in mid-air.

where: foreground roof dominating lower half of frame
desc: The oversized foreground roof fills the bottom of the screen, completely obscuring the paths and ground behind it.

verify.why: The foreground roof position is a standard camera framing choice that does not prevent viewing the village path and structures.

where: stray wooden plank on the dirt path
desc: A stray dark wooden board lies unattached in the middle of the central dirt path.

verify.why: Loose wood debris on a village path is normal environmental set dressing for a rustic construction theme.

where: support cables clipping into the cliff wall
desc: The thick support ropes at the top right clip directly into the cliff rock face without any visible anchor or pulley mechanism.

verify.why: The support ropes anchor directly into the wooden scaffolding and beam structure at the top right rather than clipping into the cliff face.

desc: Wooden beams and platform fragments float in mid-air without attachment to the dock support structure.

verify.why: The broken walkway fragments in the lower center are connected to wooden posts and structural framing representing a damaged pier.

desc: A thin roof plane floats near the top right edge without visible supporting posts or walls.

verify.why: The canopy roof at the top right is resting on visible vertical support posts and frame beams beneath it.

desc: Dense overlapping layers of wooden platforms, roofs, and railings make identifying walkable routes ambiguous.

verify.why: The complex multi-level layout is normal for a cliffside village, and walkable platforms are clearly defined by flat planking and railings.

where: center to right wooden walkways and rooftops
desc: Densely packed wooden walkways blend into building roofs and background structures, making it difficult to discern walkable paths.

verify.why: Walkable paths are clearly separated from sloped building rooftops by distinct support beams and protective railings.

desc: The dense overlap of wooden platforms, stairs, and rooftops creates visual confusion about which paths are walkable.

verify.why: The overlapping platforms and stairs are standard for vertical village art and maintain clear visual borders.

where: waterfall seam near the cliff base
desc: The waterfall geometry clips awkwardly through the rock wall, creating sharp visible polygonal edges.

verify.why: The water effect merges smoothly into the basin with specular lighting and foam, showing no harsh polygonal clipping seams at the cliff base.

desc: The massive elevated circular deck dominates the foreground and heavily occludes the walkways, stairs, and lower structures beneath it.

verify.why: Foreground deck occlusion of lower elements is a standard consequence of camera angle and architectural composition rather than a defect.

desc: The entire upper-left background is pitch black without ambient lighting or visual detail, obscuring spatial boundaries and environment depth.

verify.why: Rock wall textures and surface contours are clearly visible across the upper-left background cliff face, so it is not an unlit black void.

desc: The lantern appears to float in mid-air near the cliff edge without a clear rope or support structure.

verify.why: All lanterns throughout the scene are anchored to wooden posts, crossbeams, or roof overhangs.

desc: Deep black shadows completely obscure the background wall and water boundary, making space limits unclear.

verify.why: The shadow cast across the background cliff wall is a standard atmospheric lighting choice, and the wall geometry remains legible.
